suggestions.title: Keep input-sheet top rules visible beneath close-control drawing
suggestions.observation: The full-width 2px sheet rule near y764..766 is interrupted around x851..905 by the close-control white drawing area; both assigned Scribe entry frames show it.
suggestions.frozen_basis: Frozen HANDOFF section 4.6 requires an edge sheet with a full-width 2px top rule; section 3.4 uses explicit outlined layers.
suggestions.deduplication_note: This is the same cross-profile rule-obstruction observation as the separately requested PW cross-check, which is not included in this batch's eight-case coverage. Coordinator owns its unique map and any earlier reviewer report.
suggestions.suggested_remediation: Keep the close control's background/drawing within the sheet header below the top rule or render the rule above it, preserving a continuous full-width 2px boundary.

suggestions.title: Contain the migration chooser folio inside its complete outline
suggestions.observation: On the one-row final page, side borders stop near y418 and the white folio band runs to about y486 without a visible enclosing bottom/side rule. It also masks the top of the background migration/uninstall actions.
suggestions.frozen_basis: Frozen HANDOFF sections 3.4 and 4.6 require white 2px outlined overlay layers. The related catalog reference is not an exact migration-selector screenshot; the enclosure requirement is the shared frozen contract.
suggestions.suggested_remediation: Include the actual chooser folio in the panel's height and complete outer border, and keep all panel drawing inside that rectangle. Retain the real one-item final page and truthful disabled migration state.

suggestions.title: Use the declared source-list card-to-Add gap
suggestions.observation: The actual card ends near y424 and dashed Add starts near y456, producing about 32px of space. The original reference has about16px between these two controls.
suggestions.frozen_basis: prototype/sc-sources.dc.html:172-183 declares a 16px flex-column gap between header/card/Add. The matching original source-lists reference was reopened to distinguish this fixed gap from actual card-content height.
suggestions.suggested_remediation: Use one 16px gap between the actual repository card and Add control. Allow the card and overall panel height to follow real content without adding a second gap.
